preset.name: Marketing & brand
preset.tagline: Launch videos, campaigns, positioning, and content
preset.description: The best marketing in tech this week: launch videos, campaigns and stunts, positioning and landing pages, and the content and growth playbooks that are working.

focus.audience: a marketer at a tech company who wants to see the best launches, campaigns, and brand work
care_about: Launch videos and product launches that were marketed well, and why they worked
Ad campaigns, billboards, stunts, and rebrands from tech companies
Positioning, messaging, landing pages, and copy, with real examples
Content and social strategy that's working: founder-led content, short video, newsletters, community
Growth and demand gen playbooks with real numbers
How marketers use AI: tools, workflows, and AI-made creative
skip: Engagement bait ('comment TEMPLATE and I'll send it') and generic marketing platitudes
Politics, regulation, macro, and stock moves
Infrastructure, chips, and technical AI research
